## Per-item verdicts (each re-verified at `d24dbed8`)

| # | Finding | Verdict | Evidence / disposition |
|---|---------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | Invite over-redemption race (RH-A1-2) | **REFUTED** | `apps/api/src/invite.ts:88-109` already claims the seat in ONE atomic CTE — `used_count < max_uses` inside the `ins` arm, `on conflict (code,user_id) do nothing`, `upd` only for inserted codes; `0016_invites.sql:4` documents the design. Identical at the note's read point `ed7aef1d` — agent misread of the data-modifying CTE. |
| 2 | Duplicate personal workspaces (RH-A1-4) | **BL-115** | `provisionPersonalAccount` (`signup.ts:199-262`) gained an existing-workspace pre-read since the note, but stays non-transactional with no unique guard — concurrent provisions can still fork a second personal workspace. Auth/tenancy path → backlog. |
| 3 | Email actions consumed on GET (RH-A1-5) | **BL-116** | `notification-routes.ts` mounts `consumeSignedAction` on `GET /api/action/:token` and `GET /action/:token`; the `hold` arm mutates the gate on GET. Interstitial design = user-visible behavior → backlog (paired with RH-31's magic-link class). |
| 4 | Recipient email in logs (RH-A1-6 / N-A6 #8) | **FIXED** | `apps/worker/src/main.ts` `auth.mail` drop log now emits `job=${job.id}` — the mailbox is never logged. |
| 5 | Resend sends without `Idempotency-Key` (RH-A1-7) | **FIXED** | `MailSender.send` gained `idempotencyKey`; `handleMailSendJob` passes `mail.send:<deliveryId>` (the durable dedupe id — a claimed-not-sent re-drive reuses it); the `auth.mail` worker send passes `auth.mail:<job.id>`; `ResendMailSender` forwards it via resend@6.26 `CreateEmailRequestOptions`. Resend error throw now uses `res.error.name` (bounded enum) not provider prose. Regression test pins the delivery-keyed pass-through. |
| 6 | Plaintext `!==` email-change token (RH-A1-8) | **BL-117** | Still `parsed.token !== token` over plaintext `verification.value` at main tip (`settings-routes.ts:351-399`). 270_R6OPS.4's open PR #351 already carries `tokenHash`+`timingSafeEqual` — covered **if merged**; row records the residual. Auth posture → backlog per the ticket rule. |
| 7 | `no-raw-set-tenant` lint gap (RH-A1-9) | **BL-118** | Rule matches raw `SET` only; ~8 `set_config('app.tenant_id',…)` sites in `packages/journeys` bypass it. Rule extension + substrate disposition is its own ticket. |
| 8 | Migration runner over a pool (RH-A1-10) | **BL-119** | `apps/worker/src/migrate.ts:~227` builds `pg.Pool`; `exec`/`query` can use different connections; file+record non-atomic; no advisory lock. Deploy-critical path → backlog. |
| 9 | Duplicate dunning per workspace (RH-A2-8, latent) | **BL-120** | `runBillingPeriodTick` joins `subscriptions × workspaces` (`subscriptions.ts:407-416`) — N workspaces ⇒ N notices. Latent at one workspace today; money-adjacent → backlog. |
| 10 | Provenance SHA-prefix any length (RH-A4-5 / N-A3 #2) | **FIXED** | `check-deploy-provenance.mjs` now requires ≥7 chars on both sides of the strict prefix match AND on the deployed SHA before the REQ-ENG-8 drift arm runs — a truncated `build.gitSha` fails closed (a resolvable ≥4-char abbrev still verifies *via git* in the drift arm, which is a stronger check than the floor, not a bypass). Test pins 1/4/6-char failures. |
| 11 | No `:80` listener (N-A3 #3) | **BL-121** | `compute.ts` `GlobalForwardingRule` carries `portRange: "443"` only. New forwarding rule + redirect map is a deploy-bound infra change → backlog. |
| 12 | No Artifact-Registry cleanup policy (N-A3 #5) | **BL-122** | `compute.ts` `artifactregistry.Repository` carries no `cleanupPolicies`. Rollback-digest-safe policy design needed → backlog. |
| 13 | Docs drift (RH-A4-3) | **FIXED** | All five sites: `docs/ci.md` + `journeys.yml` comments ×2 now say scheduled journeys pin the **deployed** SHA (the `github.sha` claim was stale); `ci.yml` Turbo-cache comment `S3`→`GCS` (ADR-081); `check-licenses.mjs` docstring no longer promises the unimplemented node_modules fallback; `docs/adr/ADR-068` gained a dated amendment (accepted record, append-only) — code uses `page.evaluate`, not `addScriptTag` (CSP refusal). |
| 14 | Licence exceptions match name only (RH-A4-4) | **FIXED** | `license-policy.mjs` now fails closed when an excepted package's observed licence differs from (or misses) its recorded licence — a relicense is a new policy question. Tests pin relicense/missing/match; the real gate stayed green (`pnpm check:licenses` — 873 packages, every enumerated exception's observed licence matches). |
| 15 | `slo.probe` setInterval + invisible errors + `e.message` (N-A6 #4/#9) | **FIXED** | The 5-min sweep rides pg-boss `slo.probe` (`boss.work` + `*/5` schedule + queue row — visible in the job table, consistent with `slo.review.weekly`); `error` readings now log one `[slo] probe-error` line per tick; `slo.ts` stores `errorSummary(e)` (class + SQLSTATE/constraint tags) instead of `e.message` — a PG error message can embed row values. Boot fire + unmeasured readout unchanged. |
| 16 | Retention classes configured-not-enforced (N-A6 #6) | **BL-123** | GCS lifecycle rules target `<class>/` prefixes no code writes; `admin_actions` has no prune; SECURITY.md overstates. Per-class enforcer binding is real design work → backlog. |
| 17 | Retention-backup test can pass with no consumer (N-A6 #7) | **FIXED** | `retention-backup.test.ts` now asserts the live `boss.work(<binding>)` registrations in `main.ts` (and each binding's literal name), not the stale `WORKER_QUEUES` manifest. The manifest itself was re-synced 20→34 names to match the real createQueue list. |
| 18 | `billing-read.mjs` LB undercount (N-C2) | **FIXED** | The HTTPS-LB line now prices inbound **and** outbound data processing (~20 GB each way); Logging/Monitoring are an explicit `NOT PRICED` line instead of silently absent. |
| 19 | Raw error text outside the ADR-053 formatter (N-C5) | **FIXED (emitter class) + BL-124 residual** | Root cause: `console.error("…", err)` / `err.message` sinks print the raw stack (first line = `Error: <message>`) to stderr → Error Reporting groups on it (`run sheet: workflow "…`, `convert job run failed (403)`). Added `errorSummary`/`errorLogValue` to `@rhema/contracts` (sanitized class + bounded `code`/`constraint`/`routine`/`syscall` tags + message-stripped frames — the `claims_draft_id_fkey` diagnostic class survives) and converted ~20 sinks across `apps/api`, `apps/worker`, `apps/live-clients` (incl. the two ingest `console.warn` lines that printed upstream body text / `e.message`). Residual → **BL-124**: thrown messages embedding unbounded text (`convert …: ${detail}`, `run sheet: workflow "…"`) can still reach log headers and possibly API responses — bounding them changes user-visible text, so it went to the backlog per the ticket rule. |
| INFO | R6FIX.12 `96730839` not an ancestor of `main` | **COVERED** | The fix landed via squash-merge as `040e36a9` (#337, in main's log); only the pre-squash commit SHA is non-ancestral — expected under squash merges. |
